residual_initial_calibration.scope: Three training windows, no parameter update or validation/test selection; shared gradient diagnostic covers image projection and point MLP.

loss_definition.total: normalized padded action L1 + 10*KL + lambda*normalized point SmoothL1
loss_definition.action: Training posterior-sampled normalized L1 over all 100x12 slots with pad errors zeroed, retaining native denominator.
loss_definition.point: Mean SmoothL1 over valid withheld point/time/XYZ coordinates after displacement /0.05m; not EPE or MSE.
loss_definition.MSE: Separate validation prior-zero actual-action MSE in rad^2; never a term in these training totals.
loss_definition.percentages: Ratio of mean weighted components over the same last250 updates and four equally weighted seeds.
loss_definition.gradient_scope: Image feature input projection and point MLP only, first microbatch at update1 and every100 updates, preclip, action L1 denominator; not full actor or accumulated batch.
loss_definition.gradient_pooling: Primary median/min/max pool20 samples from four seeds and the last500 steps. Mean of four seed medians is reported separately.
loss_definition.gradient_zero: Detached auxiliary shared gradients are exactly0, not missing data.
loss_definition.clipping: Original eight conditions clip all parameters jointly at norm10; residual policy/head clip separately at norm10.

scope: Read-only accounting of frozen logs. Scalar loss fractions are not fractions of optimizer updates. Sampled gradient ratios do not establish causality.
